spec.scene: Devon suggests pizza after work Friday and the user agrees. One ordinary aside is fine.
facts: They agree to pizza this Friday at 6 pm at Luigi's on 5th Street.

dialogue: Devon: you still at work or home already
Me: just walked in like 10 mins ago
Devon: same, traffic on 5th was stupid
Me: oh yeah they're doing construction again?
Devon: yeah by the bank, took forever
Me: I just threw laundry in, what's up
Devon: was thinking we should grab pizza after work Friday
Me: oh that sounds good actually
Devon: like Luigi's on 5th Street?
Me: yes I've been craving their garlic knots
Devon: lol same, 6 pm work?
Me: yeah that works for me
Devon: perfect, we can beat the dinner rush a little
Me: did you end up finishing that report today
Devon: ugh almost, still have like one chart to fix
Me: I hate when it's just one dumb thing left
Devon: right? my boss kept pinging me about it too
Me: mine asked me to cover Saturday morning, I said no
Devon: good for you, you work too many weekends
Me: seriously, I need an actual weekend
Devon: so Friday pizza will be like a kickoff
Me: exactly, no cooking for me that night
Devon: you want to just meet there or carpool?
Me: meet there is easier, I'll be coming from office
Devon: same, I can park in back like last time
Me: oh did your mom ever call back about Sunday?
Devon: yeah we're doing lunch at hers, you're invited btw
Me: oh nice, tell her I said thanks, I might come
Devon: she makes that potato salad you like
Me: okay now I definitely have to come lol
Devon: lol I told her you'd say that
Me: wait did you see the game last night
Devon: only the highlights, that ending was wild
Me: I screamed so loud the cat ran off
Devon: hahaha poor cat
Me: she forgave me with treats
Devon: so Friday 6 still good? I have to leave work a little early
Me: yep, I'll head straight there after I clock out
Devon: cool, I'll grab us a table if I get there first
Me: sounds good, I'll text when I'm parking
Devon: btw did you pay the electric bill? I forgot last month
Me: yeah I did autopay finally, so tired of late fees
Devon: smart, I should do that too
Me: it took like 5 mins online
Devon: I'll do it tomorrow on lunch
Me: okay, pizza Friday then
Devon: yep, can't wait honestly
Me: me too, been too long since Luigi's
Devon: for real, like a month?
Me: at least, see you at 6
Devon: see ya
Me: night!
cost_note: API did not report a charge
